'''Bedlam''' was a rocky [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]]. The [[Bedlam Institution for the Criminally Demented]] was located on the planet. As of 67 BBY, its only direct transport connections were to [[Felucia]], [[Caluula]], and [[Abraxin]].<ref name="Darth P" />

The Force-sensitive Nautolan [[Naat Lare]] resided on Bedlam as a patient of the institution from approximately 62-67 BBY before escaping two months prior to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] arriving to investigate him.<ref name="Darth P" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was forced to land on the planet while [[Mission to Bedlam|pursued]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. While there, she and [[Three stormtroopers|three]] Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] encountered the powerful beings known as the [[Bedlam Spirits]].<ref name="TTS" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bedlam is English slang for an insane asylum, or wild chaotic behavior in general. It allegedly originates from a Cockney pronunciation of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bethlem_Royal_Hospital Bethlem Royal Hospital] in London.
